meta: Read blood test results with AI: understand abbreviations like GLU and LDL instead of googling symptoms and worrying.

muc.title: A confusing test result
muc.text: Holding a lab report full of abbreviations, many people google it, guess a disease and worry for nothing.

muc.title: AI explains the terms
muc.text: AI can explain what each measure, like blood sugar or cholesterol, actually measures, in plain words.

muc.title: Your doctor reads the results
muc.text: AI doesn't diagnose, because the numbers depend on age, medication and medical history. Your doctor reads the results.

muc.title: Bring questions to your appointment
muc.text: Ask AI to list questions for your doctor, and remember to cover your name and patient ID before taking a photo.

muc.title: An old test result
muc.text: Cover the name on an old test result, ask AI to explain the terms and suggest three questions for your doctor.
